card.name: Comparison phrases: greater than or equal
card.fires_on: The word 'equal' or 'than' inside 'greater than or equal to' and 'greater than' before a number. Also fires inside paired opposites such as agonist/antagonist.

modes.label: Greater than / equal to
modes.description: Comparison wording right before a numeric threshold.
modes.example: For a total volume of greater than or<< equal>> to 50 mL prepare an infusion

modes.label: Opposite pairs
modes.description: Middle of a word that names the opposite of a preceding term, like antagonist or unaware.
modes.example: OSPHENA is an estrogen agonist/ant<<agon>>ist with tissue selective effects.
